[[Frida Unmoven]] is a [[Norn]] who seems intent on keeping you out of [[Slavers' Exile]] until after she becomes famous for discovering and conquering it.

She will disappear only after completing [[EotN]].

==Locations==
* [[Tarnished Coast]]
** {{NPC location|Verdant Cascades}}

==Dialogue==
:''"Once I figure out how to get down into this place, it's mine to conquer! Then, after I become famous for discovering this area and defeating everything inside, maybe I'll let you follow in my footsteps. You'll be able to say "I knew her when....""''
